name: Pharaoh
overview: The figure of Pharaoh in Scripture is portrayed as the powerful ruler of Egypt who encountered Abram during his sojourn in Egypt. When Abram presented Sarai as his sister, Pharaoh took her into his house and treated Abram well, granting him livestock and servants. However, the LORD intervened by afflicting Pharaoh and his household with plagues because of Sarai, leading Pharaoh to confront Abram about the deception and ultimately release Sarai back to him. This account highlights God's sovereign protection over His covenant promises and His authority even over the mightiest earthly rulers.
